lead: Video-game hardware a person owns, organised by platform family: consoles and handhelds (platform → revision → region), game media as objects, controllers, accessories, modding and repair, VR & XR, and arcade and pinball machines; game titles live in the Interactive Entertainment taxonomy.

b.v: the system and its library (compatibility, backward compatibility) > performance for the price (resolution, frame rate; Pro against standard model) > disc or digital edition and storage > controller and screen
